milestone.headline: Stable sprint
milestone.context: No metric moved more than 5% from the prior sprint.
milestone.detail: A flat sprint can mean steady-state delivery or it can mean noise drowning signal -- check the Data Quality flags below to confirm field coverage is holding up before reading the flatness as good news.
milestone.action: Hold cadence. If multiple sprints in a row read stable, consider whether the +/-5% threshold is masking small but real drift -- the configurable threshold lives in build-payload.js.

watch.headline: No regressions
watch.context: No metric regressed more than 5% from the prior sprint.
watch.detail: Sustained absence of regressions is rare; verify the snapshot covers the expected window and that PR + work-item collection isn't silently dropping items.
watch.action: Spot-check the Data Quality section -- a zero-regression sprint with degraded coverage is a hidden regression.

context.headline: Data quality nominal
context.context: Every primary-metric field cleared its coverage threshold this sprint.
context.detail: Translates to: AI Efficiency, PR cycle, CFR, MTTR, and Lead Time all read on data the engine considers trustworthy. No suppression pills firing beyond the configured no-signal thresholds.
context.action: No action needed. The numbers up top are honest; trust them.
